tips: First lock the basics: complete Google Business Profile, an active WhatsApp Business number, and one clear offer.
Pick ONE channel for the first month and do it consistently — depth beats scattered effort.
Photograph real work, real faces, real products — locally relevant content beats generic stock.
Ask your first 20 customers for Google reviews and WhatsApp opt-ins; that list is your launchpad.
Repeat what brings walk-ins; drop what doesn't within 3-4 weeks.
commonMistakes: Trying every platform in week one and abandoning all by week three.
Promoting without a clear offer or next step.
No way to contact you discovered from your posts.
exampleOffers: First-visit trial or sample at a token price.
'Found us on Google' mention bonus for new customers.
Neighbourhood loyalty card: buy 5, get the 6th discounted.
